entradilla.base: We have recorded a transaction on your card ending {{ultimosDigitos}} that does not match your usual spending pattern. Nothing has been blocked: we just need you to confirm it.
entradilla.urgencia: A charge of {{importe}} at {{comercio}} has been authorised on your card ending {{ultimosDigitos}}. If this was not you, you can cancel it from the link below.
entradilla.urgencia+erratas: We have detected an UNAUTHORISED charge of {{importe}} on your card. If you do not recognise this operation you must cancel it IMMEDIATELY.

detalle.base: If the transaction is yours, simply confirm it and the charge will go through as normal. If you do not recognise it, rejecting it opens a claim and a replacement card is issued.
detalle.urgencia: Check the transaction details and tell us whether you recognise it. It takes less than a minute.
detalle.urgencia+erratas: Your card will be blocked as a precaution until you verify your identity at the link.

urgencia.base: If we do not hear from you within 72 hours the transaction will be treated as valid and can no longer be disputed through this channel.
urgencia.urgencia: You have 24 hours to reject the charge. After that the transaction settles and the claim becomes a far slower process.
urgencia.urgencia+erratas: WARNING: if you do not verify your identity within the next 2 HOURS your account will be SUSPENDED for security.
